description: Developer Panel: Create the developer's workspace with file upload, notes, and submission history
steps: Create src/components/SubmissionForm.tsx - client component for submissions
Create src/app/api/submissions/route.ts - API route for creating/fetching submissions
Create src/components/SubmissionHistory.tsx - fetch and display developer submissions
Create src/components/FilePreview.tsx - preview component for various file types
acceptance_criteria: Developer panel page verifies user role and redirects CEO
Submission form handles both file uploads and text notes
File uploader validates types and uploads to Supabase Storage
API route creates submissions and fetches current user's submissions
Submission history displays using SubmissionList with showActions=false
File preview renders appropriate UI based on file type
npm run build completes without errors
verification: Run npm run build and confirm successful compilation with zero errors
